cases.translation: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

cases.explain: «великий рог» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship Yahweh in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
